description: Party picker current-rarity borders/labels, rarity filter, level/rarity/stars default order and optional power order. New paid summons no longer autojoin. Quest panel retains giver, destinations, story, kill/collect counters and action buttons, groups rewards and item choices, and removes party portraits/enemy-stat tips. No combat balance, reward amounts or publication changes.
